AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Traffic Safety Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Traffic Safety Committee meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
The Traffic Safety Committee, at the direction of the Chairman with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City Council will take formal action to approve or deny said decisions at their meeting on Wednesday,
January 13, 2021. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the City Council with their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person must ask the City Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to "pull" the item from the Consent Calendar for discussion.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88980239534
Zoom Meeting ID: 889 8023 9534
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 889 8023 9534#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to cdpw@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all committee members. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the Traffic Safety Committee, please email cdpw@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting no later than 6:30 PM on December 2, 2020. Please note: This will be the only way to sign up for public comment.
If you wish to show any visual aids while you speak during the meeting, you may submit a PDF version (maximum 20 slides) no later than 12PM on December 2, 2020 to rolson.hrgreen@pvestates.org Each member of the public is allotted 3 minutes maximum to present.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under City Council Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.
